clips.title: The story
paras: In Gnomeregan, the Dormitory lies overrun by troggs and choked with radiation. Gnomes once lived here, but the fallen city's residential halls now belong to the creatures that drove them out.

Past the decontamination chambers of the Clean Zone, the Dormitory once housed Gnomeregan's inventors, laborers, and families. When High Tinker Mekkatorque opened the emergency radiation vents to fight the invading troggs, this crowded sector became a trap. No gnomish life remains in its communal halls or living quarters. Mutated troggs now thrive in the radioactive air. Travelers heading deeper through the city must fight through this reminder of the catastrophe to reach the lower Hall of Gears.

The abandoned living quarters still hold working machines from Gnomeregan's administration. Matrix Punchograph 3005-B terminals process security punch cards. Their cards grant access to higher-security data terminals deeper in the city, helping recover important records left behind when the gnomes fled.
